meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 Signal 收发消息，就像用手机号发短信一样。你发消息给绑定的号码，Claude 就能回复。
howto.when: 当你把 NanoClaw 链接到你的 Signal 账号，并扫描二维码完成设备绑定后触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下今天的日程安排。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Signal 回复你的日程。

say.text: 给张三发一条 Signal 消息，说项目已更新。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Signal 发送消息给张三。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages via Signal, using your linked phone number. You message the bot, and it replies through Signal.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you link NanoClaw to your Signal account by scanning a QR code during device-link setup.

say_en.note: Claude will reply via Signal with your schedule.

say_en.text: Send a Signal message to John saying the project is updated.
say_en.note: Claude will send the message via Signal to John.
